note: T-0093/T-0187 — how much of the frame is written through the plant shader's 4x4 Bayer screen door in the verge (inside 9 m), per stand, on the PUBLISHED mirror. A RECORD OF THE RESIDUE, not the gate: the gate is `handoverShare == 0` in tools/measure_near_verge.mjs and nothing here changes it. What was banked was what T-0093 did NOT close — the mid and forb rings' own OUTER coverage ramps, which at `light` detail reached in to 5.4 m and 7.4 m and so landed inside the verge on a phone. T-0187 closed it, and not by converting those boundaries: it cut their band to the ring, under the rule that an outer band may not BEGIN inside the verge (`radius - step - fringe - 9.0`). Every mobile stand is 0.000 % now, and the partial instances that remain start at 9.97 m and 10.31 m. `ditheredShare` is the union of the drawn footprints of every partially-covered plant inside 9 m as a share of the frame; `exposedShare` is that less the footprints of the solid plants in front of them, so the pair is a ceiling and a floor on the same thing. Re-bank in the SAME commit as any change that legitimately moves them, and say which way. Re-measured 2026-08-27, Chromium/SwiftShader, mobile at deviceScaleFactor 1.5 (one measured pixel = one drawing-buffer pixel; see the tool's header for why not 2).
